extracted.name: Instant Pot Salsa Chicken
extracted.description: This salsa chicken Instant Pot recipe uses frozen chicken breasts rubbed with taco seasoning, then cooked in salsa and broth for an easy Tex-Mex meal.
ingredient_lines: 1 pound frozen skinless, boneless chicken breast halves
instruction_lines: Place chicken breasts in a multi-functional cooker (such as Instant Pot). Sprinkle all sides with taco seasoning. Pour salsa and chicken broth on top.
Close and lock the lid. Select Poultry setting; set the timer for 15 minutes. Allow 10 to 15 minutes for pressure to build.
Release pressure using the natural-release method according to manufacturer’s instructions, about 20 minutes. Unlock and remove the lid.
Shred chicken and serve as desired.
